production.description: Current production-facing validation and canonical release evidence when the artifact's own status/provenance and docs/VALIDATION.md identify it as current.

audit.description: Diagnostics, preregistration, root-cause, recovery and reproducibility evidence retained without implying current production acceptance.

archive.description: Rejected or historical research remains at its original path and keeps its original rejected/invalid status.

rules: Directory membership alone never makes an artifact canonical.
Rejected or invalid artifacts must not be relabeled canonical.
Frozen evidence is not moved or rewritten merely for directory cleanup.
Engineering validation and economic acceptance remain separate.
This index is navigation metadata and never substitutes for an original artifact.
